$comment: Tests written ahead of their feature: each must FAIL until the feature is in, then come off this list. See tests/README.md (red first). Only new tests belong here; the floor guard refuses an existing test listed as pending.

pending.test: lobby stones: the 16 two-look combinations each have their own code, and a sprite in every shape
lobby stones: a combination of one look twice is that plain stone, and reverse orders are different stones
lobby stones: a stone whose left half is see-through still shows its right half
lobby stones: every combination lands and floats off through the scene's effects, in the palette
lobby stones: a board with no centre row gets a spare one, so a 5 x 6 board grows from a tengen and is cropped back
lobby stones: a 5 x 7 board has its tengen at column 3, row 4 already
lobby stones: no two stones side by side or above each other match, over 600 boards, while diagonal ones do
lobby stones: the tengen's stone is drawn with equal chance out of the 16
lobby stones: a stone sharing a colour with its source weighs 1.5 against 1, and a taken stone is out
lobby stones: the stones beside the tengen share a colour with it more often than a coin flip of the 15 others would
hover stone: it floats 2 px up and bobs by one with the clock, with a shadow under it and a glow on the up beat
lobby stones: the lobby board has seven rows, a free Extra row under Start, and a tengen at its centre
lobby stones: every point wears one of the 16 two-look stones, and none matches the point beside it or above it
lobby stones: a black stone seats a bot and is drawn as that point's own stone, and the pick count follows
lobby stones: hovering an already placed stone changes nothing: no ghost, no lift, no glow
lobby stones: hovering an empty point lifts its own stone and bobs it, as in the game
lobby stones: a white stone takes a placed bot off again
lobby stones: the free Extra row takes stones for fun, changes no pick, and a white stone takes one off
lobby stones: the keyboard reaches the free row, and the caption says it is a free point
